overview.title: Website
overview.subtitle: Manage your Academy's public website from one place.

publicUrl.label: Your website address
publicUrl.notPublishedYet: Publish your website to make this link live.

sitemapPreview.title: Sitemap preview
sitemapPreview.help: The pages a future public website would list in its sitemap, based on what's currently published, visible and indexable. Nothing here is served yet.
sitemapPreview.empty: Nothing would appear in the sitemap yet — publish your website and make sure pages are visible and indexable.

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Reusable FAQ and testimonial content, plus your blog and announcements.
content.archiveConfirmDescription: It will no longer appear on your website, even where it's referenced from a page. This does not delete it and can be reversed later.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Your Academy's knowledge blog posts, managed on their own dedicated page.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Announcements published to your students and courses.

address.title: Website address
address.redirectNote: Visitors who open {{host}} are sent to your custom domain. Both addresses keep working.
address.subdomainUntilVerified: Your custom domain becomes the primary address as soon as Atlas verifies it. Until then your Atlas subdomain is the address to share.
address.subdomainOnly: This is the address to share. Connect a custom domain below to use your own.

subdomain.title: Atlas subdomain
subdomain.help: Atlas provides this address automatically, manages its HTTPS certificate, and keeps it working even if a custom domain is disconnected.
subdomain.notConfigured: Atlas's platform domain isn't configured yet, so a subdomain address isn't available for your website. This will appear automatically once it is.

custom.title: Custom domain
custom.empty: You haven't connected a custom domain yet. Use your own address, like www.your-academy.com.
custom.added: Domain connection started — add the DNS records below
custom.addError: Failed to start connecting this domain
custom.hostnameHelp: Enter the exact address you want visitors to use, without https://. A subdomain such as learn.your-academy.com is recommended.
custom.removeConfirmDescription: Your website will fall back to its Atlas subdomain. This can be reconnected later.

checked.configure_dns: Checked — DNS records are still missing
checked.verifying: Checked — still verifying, DNS changes can take a while to propagate

custom.dnsInstructionsHelp: Add these records at the company that manages your domain's DNS. Atlas re-checks automatically every few minutes; you can also check now at any time.
custom.cnameTargetUnavailable: Atlas is not ready to route custom domains yet, so the CNAME target isn't available. Your Atlas subdomain keeps working; please try again later or contact support.
custom.dnsRecordsPending: Verification records will appear here once the domain is registered with Atlas's infrastructure provider.

stepHelp.connect: Enter the domain you want to use.
stepHelp.configure_dns: Add the DNS records below at your DNS provider, then check.
stepHelp.verifying: Atlas's infrastructure provider is validating your DNS. This usually takes minutes, sometimes up to a day.
stepHelp.live: Your domain is connected and serving your website over HTTPS.
stepHelp.attention: Something stopped this domain from working. Review the details below, fix the DNS records if needed, then check again.

provider_unavailable.title: Atlas couldn't reach its infrastructure provider
provider_unavailable.description: Nothing changed on your side. Atlas will retry automatically; you can also check again in a few minutes.

provider_hostname_missing.title: The provider no longer has a record of this domain
provider_hostname_missing.description: Disconnect the domain and connect it again to register it afresh.

provider_error.title: The last check failed
provider_error.description: The infrastructure provider didn't answer. Atlas will retry automatically; you can also check again in a few minutes.

dns_not_pointing.title: Your DNS doesn't point to Atlas yet
dns_not_pointing.description: Make sure the CNAME record below exists exactly as shown. DNS changes can take up to a day to propagate.

infrastructure.title: HTTPS & infrastructure
infrastructure.subdomainHttpsManaged: Managed by Atlas with a platform-wide certificate.
infrastructure.httpsNotProbed: Atlas checks HTTPS once the domain is connected.

platformDomain.title: Domains
platformDomain.subtitle: How every Academy website is addressed, whether custom domains are verified, and whether the infrastructure behind them is ready.
platformDomain.baseDomainHelp: Every Academy is reachable at its own slug under {{baseDomain}} — for example harvard.{{baseDomain}} — and can add a custom domain on top.
platformDomain.managedByEnvironment: Set by the deployment (PLATFORM_BASE_DOMAIN). It drives routing, the wildcard certificate and DNS, so it isn't editable here — change the deployment to change it.
platformDomain.databaseFallbackHelp: This deployment has no PLATFORM_BASE_DOMAIN set, so the value stored here is used to build Academy addresses. It performs no DNS or certificate setup by itself.
platformDomain.error: Failed to save the platform domain
platformDomain.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to the platform domain.

readiness.title: Infrastructure readiness
readiness.providerNotConnected: Cloudflare API credentials are missing or invalid
readiness.customHostnamesReady: Custom domains can be routed — a fallback origin is active
readiness.customHostnamesNotReady: Custom domains cannot be routed yet — no active fallback origin on the zone
readiness.originSslCompatible: Origin SSL mode works with the platform's origin certificate
readiness.originSslIncompatible: Origin SSL mode is "strict" — custom domains will fail at the edge
readiness.originSslUnknown: Origin SSL mode could not be read
readiness.platformHttpsReachable: The platform domain answers over HTTPS
readiness.platformHttpsUnreachable: The platform domain does not answer over HTTPS
readiness.wildcardUnreachable: Academy subdomains do not answer over HTTPS
readiness.checkedAt: Checked {{time}} — every line is a live answer from the provider or a live probe.

operations.title: Academy website addresses
operations.searchPlaceholder: Search by academy, organization or hostname
operations.emptyDescription: Adjust the search or filters to see other academies.

notFound.title: Website not found
notFound.description: We couldn't find a website at this address.

unavailable.title: Temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: This website can't be reached right now. Please try again shortly.

unpublished.title: Coming soon
unpublished.description: This website hasn't been published yet.

pageNotFound.title: Page not found
pageNotFound.description: This page doesn't exist or is no longer available.

settings.title: Website
settings.subtitle: Configure your Academy's public website — theme, branding, SEO and navigation.

modernEducation.name: Modern Education
modernEducation.description: Friendly and approachable, with a split hero and elevated cards.

premiumAcademy.name: Premium Academy
premiumAcademy.description: Upscale and elegant, with a centered hero and generous whitespace.

corporateLearning.name: Corporate Learning
corporateLearning.description: Structured and professional, built for enterprise training providers.

minimalEditorial.name: Minimal Editorial
minimalEditorial.description: Restrained and typographic, letting your content speak for itself.

boldCreative.name: Bold Creative
boldCreative.description: Energetic and expressive, for academies that want to stand out.

brand.contrastWarning: This color may be hard to read as text on a light background.
brand.darkLogoHelp: Used wherever the theme places your logo on a dark surface.
brand.primaryLogoNote: Your primary logo and favicon are managed on your Academy's Branding page.

seo.canonicalBaseUrlHelp: A real, verified domain is connected later in your website's lifecycle — this is only used to compose canonical links once it is.
seo.robotsIndexable: Allow search engines to index this website
seo.sitemapEnabled: Include this website in the sitemap
seo.indexable: Allow search engines to index this page
seo.structuredDataPreviewHelp: A preview of the structured data (JSON-LD) a future public website would publish for search engines and social platforms — nothing here is published yet.
seo.resolvedFallbackHint: If you leave the fields below blank, this page currently falls back to: "{{title}}" / "{{description}}".

navigation.authPagesDescription: Sign In and Sign Up are fixed pages that already use your logo, colors, and footer — customize just their heading text here. Leave a field blank to use the default wording.

pages.title: Pages
pages.subtitle: Your website's core and custom pages.
pages.deleteConfirmDescription: "{{title}}" and its content will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

editor.title: Page Editor
editor.subtitle: Compose this page from sections, then save your changes.
editor.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to this page.
editor.deleteConfirmDescription: This section and its content will be removed from the page. This cannot be undone.
editor.invalidConfig: Some values need to be corrected before this can be saved.
editor.libraryEntriesHelpFaq: Published FAQ entries you select here appear on this section, alongside any items added directly below.
editor.libraryEntriesHelpTestimonials: Published testimonials you select here appear on this section, alongside any items added directly below.
editor.invalidSections: These sections need attention before this page can be saved: {{sections}}.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: See your draft website exactly as the renderer will produce it.

publish.confirmDescription: Your draft configuration will become live for every visitor.
publish.unpublishConfirmDescription: Visitors will no longer be able to reach your academy's public website. You can publish it again at any time.
publish.unpublishedHint: Your website is offline and not reachable by visitors.

renderer.contactSuccess: Thanks — your message has been sent.
renderer.contactError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

courseDetails.enrollError: We couldn't enroll you in this course. Please try again.

common.imageInvalidType: This file type isn't supported. Use PNG, JPG or WEBP.

presence.manyEditing: {{name}} and {{count}} others are currently editing this page.

conflict.title: This page changed while you were editing
conflict.description: Someone saved a newer version of this page.
conflict.descriptionNamed: {{name}} saved a newer version while you were editing.
conflict.explainer: Reload to see their version and start again from it, or keep your changes and apply them on top of theirs. Their work is never discarded either way.
